title: import
description: Payload of `stride import <dir>` — a Strava bulk-export archive read from disk. `imported` counts rows that PARSED and were upserted into the mirror tier; `skipped` counts rows that could not be parsed. Neither is a diff against what the database already held: an activity that was already present is upserted again and counts as `imported`, so re-running the same export returns the same numbers every time (the row COUNT in the database is idempotent, the reported counts are not — they describe the archive, not the change). Neither number is an error signal; a failure is an error envelope, not a zero.
